name: Climb to Snipe
desc:
CLIMB THE TOWER AND BECOME THE SNIPER 🎯

[UPDATE 2.0]

- New coils!
- Now you create loadouts with items
- Bug fixes
- Quality of life

Spend your cash on TROLL gadgets to mess with your rivals.

✨ Use Parkour skills to dodge bullets and traps!
💣 Stop other climbers!
💎 Loot fallen players for cash and get rich! 

How to Play:

➡️ Ride the Elevator - New waves start every 30 seconds!
💵Buy items - They can help your climb or mess other climbers!
🧗 Climb & Dodge - Watch out for the Sniper scope and traps.
🏆 Touch the Top - Instantly BECOME THE SNIPER!
💥 Eliminate Climbers - Defend your spot at the summit!

Non-stop action. No rounds. Just climb or shoot!
